argv:
A Meridian-3 has stopped reporting. How long can it keep working
offline, and how would I detect that from the Fleet Control API?

parsed.answer:
A Meridian-3 can keep working offline for up to **12 minutes** — that is the offline autonomy window buffered on board the robot. If the buffered queue is exhausted before 12 minutes, the window ends early (whichever comes first). [sample_corpus/product-specs.md:Acme Robotics — Product Specifications > Meridian-3 Autonomous Mobile Robot > Offline Autonomy]

To detect this from the Fleet Control API:

1. **Check `link_state`**: Poll `GET /robots/{robot_id}/telemetry`. When `link_state` reads `offline`, it means no report has been received for more than 30 seconds. [sample_corpus/api-reference.md:Fleet Control API Reference > Fleet Telemetry > GET /robots/{robot_id}/telemetry]

2. **Watch `offline_seconds`**: This field counts up from the last successful report. When it crosses 12 minutes (720 seconds), the robot has almost certainly performed a safe-park — it will have finished its current motion segment, moved to the nearest designated safe-park zone, and set its beacon to amber. Fleet Control does not itself decide when the robot parks; the robot makes that call on board, so `offline_seconds` crossing the window is your signal. [sample_corpus/api-reference.md:Fleet Control API Reference > Fleet Telemetry > GET /robots/{robot_id}/telemetry] [sample_corpus/product-specs.md:Acme Robotics — Product Specifications > Meridian-3 Autonomous Mobile Robot > Offline Autonomy]

3. **Listen for webhooks**: You will receive a `robot.link_lost` event and `link_state` will flip to `offline` when the link drops. On reconnect, you will get `robot.link_restored` and — if the robot did safe-park — a `robot.safe_parked` event and an amber `beacon`. [sample_corpus/faq.md:Frequently Asked Questions > Fleet Operations > What happens during a network outage?]

4. **Amber beacon after reconnect**: If the beacon stays amber for more than a minute after the link returns, the robot needs a physical check. [sample_corpus/faq.md:Frequently Asked Questions > Fleet Operations > What happens during a network outage?] [sample_corpus/support-runbook.md:Support Runbook > Many Robots Offline at Once]
